source._comment: Louisiana SoS publishes early-voting statistics as PDFs on electionstatistics.sos.la.gov. The STATEWIDE file has one clean row per parish: after the 'PARISH-##' token come 15 numbers in this order -> VOTES, WHITE, BLACK, OTHER, MALE, FEMALE, DEM, REP, OTH, IN, OUT, INPER, ABS, D, I. VOTES == DEM+REP+OTH (full partisan partition of the early-vote electorate). Files are named by election date: <YYYY>_<MMDD>_StatewideStats.pdf (Nov 3 2026 -> 2026_1103). The 2026 general file appears when early voting opens (~late Oct); until then this reads 0. Requires pypdf (installed in the LA workflow step). validation_file is the persisted final 2024 file, used by --validate to prove the parser.
